articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs only modestly as Nasdaq soars 6% on Huang return
articles.snippet: Nvidia is higher by 30% after the company board announced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and director.

articles.title: Japan to ramp up crypto tax audits after uncovering $24.5 million in hidden income
articles.snippet: On-site audits of individual crypto traders averaged 12.58 million yen in extra tax per case, nearly triple the bureau's standard audit average.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs back above $61,000 as stocks rebound from AI rout
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is recovering from a weekend plunge to nearly $55,500, its lowest in more than two years, as Nasdaq futures jumped 3% and Nvidia rallied.

articles.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

articles.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
articles.snippet: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.
